subject: column systems
outcome: Unique, selectable shafts, capitals and abaci represent 46 external peristyle shafts, 12 additional porch shafts and four western Ionic shafts; east two-tier colonnade is interpretive. Exterior shaft height and bays follow published aggregate measurements.
acceptanceCriteriaReviewed: Build separately identifiable supports, shafts and capitals at documented positions
Verify count, rhythm, proportions and refinements within declared tolerances
validation: Architecture unit checks and rendered Chromium desktop/mobile review; relevant scene behavior inspected in source and QA captures.
limits: Detailed entasis, individual optical leaning, capital refinements and eastern interior pier pattern are not survey-validated.

review.note: Deliverable is implemented in independently authored project code and checked against recorded public evidence and browser tests.
